entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ibn Sab'in was an Arab Sufi, philosopher from al-Andalus in the west land of Islamic world. He was born in 1217 in modern-day Ricote in Murcia. It has been suggested that he was a Neoplatonic philosopher, a Peripatetic philosopher, a Pythagorean philosopher, a Hermeticist, an alchemist, a heterodox Sufi, a pantheist, though none of these adequately characterise Ibn Sab'in. He was also known for his knowledge of esotericism and was well versed in the knowledge of Islam and of other religions.
